claim.quote: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT

date.note: First public posting (arXiv v1, 14 October 2021), before the journal publication (Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 081801, DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.129.081801 as given by the arXiv abstract page); the display date is the earliest public date (A9).

key_value.note: All CsI[Na] data collected before detector decommissioning (the abstract says the dataset was more than doubled since the first observation), with an updated quenching model. Value derived from the quote: (165 +30/−25) × 10⁻⁴⁰ cm² = 1.65 × 10⁻³⁸ cm² (+0.30 × 10⁻³⁸/−0.25 × 10⁻³⁸).
key_value.quote: cross section to be (165^{+30}_{-25})x10^{-40} cm^2, consistent with the standard model

key_value_text.quote: This result places leading constraints on neutrino non-standard interactions while testing lepton flavor universality ... and measures the weak mixing angle as sin2 θW = 0.220+0.028 −0.026 at Q ≈ (50 MeV)
key_value_text.value: Weak mixing angle sin²θW = 0.220 (+0.028/−0.026) at Q² ~ (50 MeV)², alongside constraints on non-standard interactions and a test of lepton flavor universality using the neutrino beam's timing structure

name: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT

significance.note: The abstract fetched this session does not restate a single overall significance figure for the full dataset (the original 2017 observation's 6.7σ is superseded but not re-quoted here); left uncertain rather than inferred.

summary.plain: COHERENT re-measured the rate of neutrinos scattering coherently off caesium-iodide nuclei with more than twice the data of the first observation and a better model of nuclear recoils in the crystal. The collaboration calls it the most precise measurement of the process yet, and extracts the weak mixing angle at a momentum transfer near 50 MeV.
summary.technical: All CsI[Na] data collected before detector decommissioning (13.99 GWhr of integrated beam power passing the livetime criteria), more than doubling the dataset of the first observation, with an updated quenching model reducing systematic uncertainties: cross section (165 +30/−25)×10⁻⁴⁰ cm², consistent with the Standard Model and called the most precise measurement of CEvNS yet; weak mixing angle sin²θW = 0.220 +0.028/−0.026 at Q² ≈ (50 MeV)²; the collaboration reports leading constraints on neutrino non-standard interactions and a lepton-flavor-universality test using the beam's timing structure.

title: Measurement of the Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering Cross Section on CsI by COHERENT
why_it_matters: A CEvNS cross-section measurement on CsI with more than twice the data of the first observation. The abstract reports leading constraints on neutrino non-standard interactions, a test of lepton flavor universality using the timing structure of the neutrino beam, and the weak mixing angle at Q ≈ 50 MeV.
